subject.title: fix(gateway): regenerate native hook descriptors when relay unavailable after restart

question: Should an unavailable Codex native relay remain fail-closed until it is re-registered, or may app-server approvals intentionally fall back to generic `before_tool_call` policy?
rationale: Codex exposes distinct PreToolUse and PermissionRequest semantics, and this patch changes the enforcement path without proving that every native approval and trusted-policy invariant is equivalent.

options.title: Repair relay lifecycle
options.body: Keep unknown relay failures fail-closed and fix registration, generation, or session rebinding so the native relay becomes available again.

options.title: Accept guarded fallback
options.body: Permit fallback only for a narrowly classified missing or stale relay error, with live tests proving equivalent policy and approval enforcement.

options.title: Accept broad fallback
options.body: Intentionally allow all native relay invocation errors to use generic policy evaluation and document that as the permanent security boundary.

recommendation.title: Repair relay lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep unknown relay failures fail-closed and fix registration, generation, or session rebinding so the native relay becomes available again.

likelyOwner.reason: The guarded fail-closed/no-policy fallback contract and adjacent relay lifecycle fixes were merged under this ownership trail.
